title: Japanese Zucchini and Onions
description: This Japanese zucchini and onion stir-fry recipe, with sesame seeds, teriyaki, and soy sauces, comes together in minutes to make a tasty vegetarian meal.
ingredients: 2 medium zucchinis, cut into thin strips

steps.text: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion; cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add zucchini, teriyaki sauce, soy sauce, and sesame seeds; cook until zucchini are tender, about 5 minutes. Season with pepper. Serve immediately.

video.description: The Japanese steak house favorite is quick to make and goes well with grilled steak, chicken or shrimp! What’s more, it’s a great way to use up an over-abundance of summer zucchini, too! Get your oil hot in a wok or skillet, then stir in onions and cook until softened. Stir in strips of zucchini and toss with teriyaki sauce, soy sauce and sesame seeds. Cook until tender and serve with a seasoning of black pepper. Great as a side dish or served over rice with a grilled meat entrée.
